scope: Engineering envelope for a 28 nm bulk CMOS MASK ROM; not a foundry-calibrated radiation model

literature_anchors.advanced_node_threshold_resolution: Many advanced-node points have |delta Vth| below 3 mV at 500 krad(SiO2); 14.32 krad is below the directly measured range.
literature_anchors.28nm_short_nmos_at_1_grad: Approximately -20 mV delta Vth for a wide, minimum-length nMOS at 1 Grad(SiO2).
literature_anchors.28nm_nmos_at_1_grad: Most tested nMOS devices remained within about 30 mV delta Vth, while leakage increased strongly only at ultrahigh dose.
literature_anchors.low_dose_limitation: The 28 nm CERN measurement series generally starts at 0.5 Mrad(SiO2), so no unique fitted coefficient is justified at 14.32 krad(Si).

published_closest_geometry_extrapolation.device_geometry: commercial 28 nm bulk nMOS, W/L = 100 nm/30 nm, one finger
published_closest_geometry_extrapolation.warning: Extrapolated below the paper's first measured point of 0.5 Mrad; use the multiplier as a nominal literature anchor, not a validated low-dose fit.

usage_note: Run all three corners. Report the central value and the full central-to-stress spread. Do not report the conservative or stress values as measured coefficients.
